label: A girl who brings heavenly worship like a fragrance
description: A girl seen who will bring heavenly worship that is a fragrance, whose home he says he can see. Given 23 November 2025.

label: Canada becomes a distribution centre for creative ideas
description: Creative ideas coming to Canadians as the finances dry up, making Canada a distribution centre with a well of revival money. Given 22 and 23 November 2025.

label: A revival among American Indians in the southwest
description: A great revival on tribal land in Arizona among American Indians, extending over Mexico, New Mexico and into Colorado. Given 22 and 23 November 2025.

label: A lion on the New York Stock Exchange, with tumbleweeds
description: A lion he is told to pay attention to, seen on the New York Stock Exchange, with tumbleweeds rolling down the main street. Given 22 November 2025.

label: South Korea a hub, and a pillar of revival spreading from it
description: South Korea named as a hub from which a major pillar of revival springs and spreads through China and Vietnam, with an effect reaching Alaska and Hawaii. Given 22 November 2025.
aliases: south korea will be a hub

label: Tunnels under the border wall with children coming up in California
description: Underground tunnels at the border wall with children coming up through California, and the governor turning his head away because he knew. Given 20 November 2025.
aliases: underground tunnels on the border wall

label: Woe pronounced over America and over Miami
description: Woe said three times over America and three times over Miami, following a vision he says changed him. Given 20 November 2025.

label: Millions or billions of dead fish, including at Honolulu
description: Dead fish seen in millions if not billions, everywhere, including Hawaii and Honolulu. Given 20 November 2025.

label: A true revival comes to the Roman Catholic Church
description: Great revival coming to the Roman Catholic Church including Rome and the Vatican, with doctrinal issues addressed. Given November and December 2025.
aliases: revival will hit the catholic church
revival will come to the roman catholic
